## Section 1. Retrieve Coding Sequence Information (Annotation)

```{r codon-table}
codon_table <- c(
  TTT="Phe", TTC="Phe", TTA="Leu", TTG="Leu",
  CTT="Leu", CTC="Leu", CTA="Leu", CTG="Leu",
  ATT="Ile", ATC="Ile", ATA="Ile", ATG="Met",
  GTT="Val", GTC="Val", GTA="Val", GTG="Val",

  TCT="Ser", TCC="Ser", TCA="Ser", TCG="Ser",
  CCT="Pro", CCC="Pro", CCA="Pro", CCG="Pro",
  ACT="Thr", ACC="Thr", ACA="Thr", ACG="Thr",
  GCT="Ala", GCC="Ala", GCA="Ala", GCG="Ala",

  TAT="Tyr", TAC="Tyr", TAA="Stop", TAG="Stop",
  CAT="His", CAC="His", CAA="Gln", CAG="Gln",
  AAT="Asn", AAC="Asn", AAA="Lys", AAG="Lys",
  GAT="Asp", GAC="Asp", GAA="Glu", GAG="Glu",

  TGT="Cys", TGC="Cys", TGA="Stop", TGG="Trp",
  CGT="Arg", CGC="Arg", CGA="Arg", CGG="Arg",
  AGT="Ser", AGC="Ser", AGA="Arg", AGG="Arg",
  GGT="Gly", GGC="Gly", GGA="Gly", GGG="Gly"
)
```

### Convert the FASTA file into an RDS file

This chunk reads the FASTA file with Biostrings and turns it into an RDS file.
If the RDS file already exists, it won't rerun every time you knit

```{r fasta-to-rds}
# used for reading the FASTA
library(Biostrings) 

 # used to split the strings in header
library(stringr)

fasta_path <- "Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.cds.all.fa"
rds_path   <- "Homo_sapiens_GRCh38_cds.rds"

if (!file.exists(rds_path)) {

  # Read the FASTA file
  fasta <- readDNAStringSet(fasta_path)

  # full header line for each record, minus ">"
  headers  <- names(fasta)          
  # full CDS sequence for each record, as a string
  cds_seqs <- as.character(fasta)  

  # Parse the header fields

  # Takes string before first space "ENST"
  transcript_full <- str_extract(headers, "^\\S+")
   # Gets the ID without decimal
  TranscriptID    <- str_split_fixed(transcript_full, "\\.", 2)[, 1]
   # full ID version with decimal
  TranscriptIDv   <- transcript_full

  # Same as above section with decimals "ENSG"

  gene_full <- str_remove(str_extract(headers, "gene:\\S+"), "^gene:")
  GeneID    <- str_split_fixed(gene_full, "\\.", 2)[, 1]
  GeneIDv   <- gene_full

  # Finds string that says "gene symbol: ..." but removes "gene symbol:"
  gene_name <- str_remove(str_extract(headers, "gene_symbol:\\S+"), "^gene_symbol:")

  # Make the data frame
  cds <- data.frame(
    GeneName      = gene_name,
    GeneID        = GeneID,
    GeneIDv       = GeneIDv,
    TranscriptID  = TranscriptID,
    TranscriptIDv = TranscriptIDv,
    CDS           = cds_seqs,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  cat("Rows parsed:", nrow(cds), "\n")
  cat("Records missing GeneName:", sum(is.na(cds$GeneName)), "\n")

  # save as the RDS file
  saveRDS(cds, rds_path)

} else {
  cds <- readRDS(rds_path)
}
```
